list.title: Invoices
list.search_placeholder: Search by athlete or invoice number...

billing_tab.auto_switch_desc: The system prepares the invoices for all athletes on its own, on the day you choose. They stay as drafts: nothing goes out until you send it, or until you turn on automatic sending below.
billing_tab.auto_off_note: With automatic creation off, you prepare the invoices yourself using the button further down.
billing_tab.email_auto_label: Send invoices automatically, without anyone pressing Send
billing_tab.email_auto_desc: Every invoice created by the system is sent to the family's address and marked as sent. Invoices with a zero amount, without an address, or with incomplete payment details are skipped.
billing_tab.email_auto_warning: For emails to actually arrive, a verified sending domain is required. Until then, sends are recorded as failed and the invoices stay where they are.
billing_tab.reminder_switch_label: Notify the family when an invoice is overdue
billing_tab.reminder_switch_desc: Once the due date has passed, the system sends a reminder and marks the invoice as reminded.
billing_tab.reminder_days_help: For example 7, 21: the first reminder one week after the due date, the second three weeks after.
billing_tab.reminder_days_invalid: Enter the days separated by commas, for example 7, 21
